visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a grey tank top and beige shorts walks away from the camera in a bustling market environment. He is carrying a large plastic bag containing several food containers. In the background, other shoppers are visible, and food stalls with signage for various meats are seen under bright, mixed lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the same man, now identified as a chef, wearing glasses and purple gloves. He is working at a food stall, pouring white rice batter onto a large rectangular metal tray with a ladle. He then squeezes a yellow liquid (egg) and places a long strip of pink meat and a handful of bean sprouts onto the batter. (3) The chef slides the tray into a tiered metal steamer. After a brief moment, he pulls it out, using a white scraper to fold and roll the steamed rice noodle. The texture of the food appears soft and white. (4) A series of extreme close-ups follow, showing a bowl of the completed dish topped with several pink shrimps and green vegetables. A spoon drizzles red chili oil and a dark, translucent sauce over the food. Chopsticks are used to lift a portion of the glistening noodles. (5) Another variation of the dish is shown, topped with small dried shrimps (sakura shrimp) and more sauce. This is followed by a shot of a small bowl containing chunks of steamed meat in a dark sauce. (6) The video concludes with the chef continuing to prepare food, followed by a shot of a detailed menu board displaying prices and dish names. The final frame shows a sign with the brand's cartoon logo and name.
